The '''Pybus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pybus]].
